main_topics.reason: The user opened with flares during stressful work weeks and the whole conversation addresses that pattern.
The user asked what to do on a Tuesday morning with back-to-back meetings, and the bot covered antispasmodics and loperamide over several turns.

The user was surprised it can be taken before symptoms and asked about it; the bot covered dosing caution.

output.summary: A user with IBS described diarrhea-predominant flares triggered by work stress and asked what could help, both long-term and on a bad morning. The bot explained the gut-brain link, suggested hypnotherapy and CBT, antispasmodics, preemptive loperamide and cutting caffeine, and built a two-layer plan. The user said it was helpful and not the usual runaround, and left with things to try and a way to raise it with their doctor.
